question: Do the remaining exclusive slots within the SAME original top20 contain another actionable local sharing candidate, after known exposure and closed-mechanism exclusion?
selection: Keep original order and method-exclusive top20 membership. Inherit all original exclusions; exclude all six pairs of original subset review. Exclude any pair touching the Weak collector, deletion transaction and formatter units in original subset slots 1,4,6 as closed mechanisms. Independent registry audit may add previously exposed pairs before packaging; explicit amendment required if it changes the queue. Never read candidate snippets before selection freeze.
exhaustion: Leave slots empty, no other-method substitution, no later ranks or threshold changes.
review: Two fresh non-fork reviewers split selected cases in queue order. Supply sources and metadata without method/score/rank; no claim of scientific blinding or independent labels. Max3 cases each,15min each, full containing files plus directly named helper/tests from SAME archive. No production edits, builds, tests, new search, or broad platform construction.
outputs: Existing delegation or independent common mechanism
One specific adoption-changing obligation and existing verification entry, or explicit lack
Source citations and actual read scope/cost
stop: After at most six slots, synthesize all outcomes. If no new candidate with obligation and concrete verification entry, close this queue expansion; no extra ranking or frontend tuning. If any qualify, choose first by frozen slot order for a later admission, not by method or perceived easiest success.
limits: Development corpus already exposed. Unreviewed pair does not mean unseen functions, files or mechanisms. Exclusion registries are a finite documented inventory, not exhaustive history certification. No precision/recall or method winner estimate.
